LESSON: CALL TO PROPHETHOOD

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: History of Islam
Topic 7.1: Call to Prophethood
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Call to Prophethood, part of History of Islam in Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: What are the teachings of the first five verses revealed to Prophet (S.A.W)?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

F. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. watch audio-visual clip/listen to a story from a digital device/resource person on Prophet’s experience at cave Hira,

2. read from reference material story on call to prophethood and narrates to others in class,

3. recite the first five verses of Suratul- Alaq, individually/in groups,

4. discuss the significance of the first five verses of Suratul-Alaq and write the points in their notebook.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. watch audio-visual clip/listen to a story from a digital device/resource person on Prophet’s experience at cave Hira,
2. read from reference material story on call to prophethood and narrates to others in class,
3. recite the first five verses of Suratul- Alaq, individually/in groups,
4. discuss the significance of the first five verses of Suratul-Alaq and write the points in their notebook.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Call to Prophethood together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and collaboration: the skill of writing and teamwork is enhanced as learners discuss the teachings from the

first five verses of Suratul-Alaq, in pairs/groups, and write the points in their notebook.

• Learning to learn: the skill of sharing learnt knowledge is enhanced as learners read from reference material story on call to

prophethood and narrates to others in class.

• Digital literacy: the skill of interacting with digital technology is enhanced as learners watch audio-visual clip/listen to a

story from a digital device/resource person on Prophet’s experience at cave Hira.

Values:
• Respect: open mindedness enhanced as learners respect each other’s opinions while discussing the teachings from the first

five verses of Suratul-Alaq.

• Responsibility: accountability enhanced as learners recite the first five verses of Suratul-Alaq, individually/in groups.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Empathy as learners learn how the Prophet (S.A.W) received divine guidance.

Link to other Learning Areas: The concept of reading first five verses of Surah-Alaq can be related to skills in English.
